subject_rule: Open to any subject: the Gates Cambridge Trust funds a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge; the only limits are on degree type (full-time one-year master's courses, MLitt and PhD) and a list of excluded courses, not on field of study.

notes: No list of majors exists for this scholarship because the field of study is open. Any subject taught at Cambridge at PhD, MLitt or one-year full-time master's level is allowed; the programme rows record the eligible degree types only (4 master's types, 1 doctoral type).

Courses the Gates Cambridge Trust does NOT consider (eligibility page): any undergraduate degree (BA, or a second BA as an affiliated student); MASt courses; part-time degrees other than the PhD; professional development courses and non-standard degrees such as Master of Business (MBA), Executive MBA and Global EMBA, Master of Finance (MFin), Executive Master of Accounting, Business Doctorate (BusD), Postgraduate Certificate of Education (PGCE), MBBChir Clinical Studies, MD Doctor of Medicine (6 years, part-time, home students only), Graduate Course in Medicine (A101), and Master of Conservation of Easel Painting.
The FAQ page also lists PGCert, PGDip, MSt and Doctor of Education as not eligible, in addition to the courses above.
The eligibility page names PhD, MLitt and 'a one-year postgraduate course (full-time) with some exceptions'; the FAQ names MPhil, MLitt, MRes, LLM and PhD.
not_stated: No list of individual Cambridge subjects or courses; the Trust refers applicants to the University's own course directory (not opened because the scholarship has no subject limit).
Whether MCL and MAcc are eligible is not stated on the pages read.
fetch_problems: The University of Cambridge graduate course directory was not read: it is the university's list of all courses, not a Gates Cambridge subject list, and the scholarship does not limit subjects.
